# Attachment help exposes the complete local file workflow without requiring
# external skill documentation.
exec card attachment --help
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/attachment.txt
! stderr .

exec card attachment add --help
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/add.txt
! stderr .

exec card attachment show --help
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/show.txt
! stderr .

exec card attachment list --help
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/list.txt
! stderr .

exec card attachment get --help
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/get.txt
! stderr .

exec card attachment remove --help
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/remove.txt
! stderr .

exec card attachment gc --help
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/gc.txt
! stderr .

-- golden/attachment.txt --
Usage: card attachment <command> [flags]

Add, inspect, download, remove, and collect board attachments.

Add, inspect, download, remove, and collect board attachments. Attachment
references use attachment:<id> and remain scoped to their board.

Managing attachments
  attachment add       Upload a file or standard input.
  attachment show      Show attachment metadata.
  attachment list      List attachment metadata.
  attachment get       Download verified attachment content.
  attachment remove    Permanently tombstone an attachment.
  attachment gc        Collect expired staging and orphan blob content.

Flags:
  -h, --help    Show context-sensitive help.

Global flags
      --store=PATH     Physical Cardamom store directory. Overrides automatic
                       discovery ($CARDAMOM_STORE).
      --board=BOARD    Coordination board ID or exact name ($CARDAMOM_BOARD).
      --actor=ACTOR    Identity that owns active claims and attributes changes.
                       Defaults to the current OS username ($CARDAMOM_ACTOR).
      --json           Emit machine-readable JSON or JSON Lines output.
  -q, --quiet          Suppress status notices while preserving requested output
                       and errors.
-- golden/add.txt --
Usage: card attachment add <source> [flags]

Upload a file or standard input.

Upload a file or standard input in bounded chunks and publish it as one board
attachment. Use - to read standard input; --name is required in that form.
On success, the command prints the attachment ID, canonical Markdown link,
and canonical Markdown image reference.

Arguments:
  <source>    File path, or - to read standard input.

Flags:
  -h, --help           Show context-sensitive help.

      --name=NAME      Portable attachment filename. Required for standard
                       input; otherwise defaults to the source basename.
      --issue=ISSUE    Originating issue ID. The association is organizational
                       and does not restrict same-board references.

Global flags
      --store=PATH     Physical Cardamom store directory. Overrides automatic
                       discovery ($CARDAMOM_STORE).
      --board=BOARD    Coordination board ID or exact name ($CARDAMOM_BOARD).
      --actor=ACTOR    Identity that owns active claims and attributes changes.
                       Defaults to the current OS username ($CARDAMOM_ACTOR).
      --json           Emit machine-readable JSON or JSON Lines output.
  -q, --quiet          Suppress status notices while preserving requested output
                       and errors.
-- golden/list.txt --
Usage: card attachment list [flags]

List attachment metadata.

List one stable page of attachment metadata for the selected board. Use --issue
to restrict the originating issue, --include-removed to include tombstones,
and --after with next_page_token to continue a previous listing.

Flags:
  -h, --help               Show context-sensitive help.

      --issue=ISSUE        Restrict results to this originating issue.
      --include-removed    Include permanently tombstoned attachment metadata.
      --limit=COUNT        Maximum attachments in this page. Zero selects the
                           default limit.
      --after=TOKEN        Continue after the opaque token returned as
                           next_page_token.

Global flags
      --store=PATH     Physical Cardamom store directory. Overrides automatic
                       discovery ($CARDAMOM_STORE).
      --board=BOARD    Coordination board ID or exact name ($CARDAMOM_BOARD).
      --actor=ACTOR    Identity that owns active claims and attributes changes.
                       Defaults to the current OS username ($CARDAMOM_ACTOR).
      --json           Emit machine-readable JSON or JSON Lines output.
  -q, --quiet          Suppress status notices while preserving requested output
                       and errors.
-- golden/get.txt --
Usage: card attachment get <id> <output> [flags]

Download verified attachment content.

Write verified attachment content to a new local file. The command verifies the
complete content before writing it. An existing output file is replaced only
when --force is supplied.

Arguments:
  <id>        Attachment ID.
  <output>    Destination file path.

Flags:
  -h, --help     Show context-sensitive help.

      --force    Replace an existing output file instead of requiring a new
                 path.

Global flags
      --store=PATH     Physical Cardamom store directory. Overrides automatic
                       discovery ($CARDAMOM_STORE).
      --board=BOARD    Coordination board ID or exact name ($CARDAMOM_BOARD).
      --actor=ACTOR    Identity that owns active claims and attributes changes.
                       Defaults to the current OS username ($CARDAMOM_ACTOR).
      --json           Emit machine-readable JSON or JSON Lines output.
  -q, --quiet          Suppress status notices while preserving requested output
                       and errors.
-- golden/gc.txt --
Usage: card attachment gc [flags]

Collect expired staging and orphan blob content.

Collect expired staging files and unreferenced blobs explicitly. Collection
is store-wide, reports retained content integrity problems, and never changes
attachment metadata. Use --dry-run to report what collection would remove
without deleting bytes.

Flags:
  -h, --help       Show context-sensitive help.

      --dry-run    Report what collection would remove without deleting local
                   content.

Global flags
      --store=PATH     Physical Cardamom store directory. Overrides automatic
                       discovery ($CARDAMOM_STORE).
      --board=BOARD    Coordination board ID or exact name ($CARDAMOM_BOARD).
      --actor=ACTOR    Identity that owns active claims and attributes changes.
                       Defaults to the current OS username ($CARDAMOM_ACTOR).
      --json           Emit machine-readable JSON or JSON Lines output.
  -q, --quiet          Suppress status notices while preserving requested output
                       and errors.
-- golden/show.txt --
Usage: card attachment show <id>

Show attachment metadata.

Show one attachment's board association, immutable blob descriptor, lifecycle,
replica-local availability, and mutation attribution.

Arguments:
  <id>    Attachment ID.

Flags:
  -h, --help    Show context-sensitive help.

Global flags
      --store=PATH     Physical Cardamom store directory. Overrides automatic
                       discovery ($CARDAMOM_STORE).
      --board=BOARD    Coordination board ID or exact name ($CARDAMOM_BOARD).
      --actor=ACTOR    Identity that owns active claims and attributes changes.
                       Defaults to the current OS username ($CARDAMOM_ACTOR).
      --json           Emit machine-readable JSON or JSON Lines output.
  -q, --quiet          Suppress status notices while preserving requested output
                       and errors.
-- golden/remove.txt --
Usage: card attachment remove <id>

Permanently tombstone an attachment.

Permanently tombstone one attachment. Removal is permanent and does not by
itself delete the retained immutable blob from local storage.

Arguments:
  <id>    Attachment ID.

Flags:
  -h, --help    Show context-sensitive help.

Global flags
      --store=PATH     Physical Cardamom store directory. Overrides automatic
                       discovery ($CARDAMOM_STORE).
      --board=BOARD    Coordination board ID or exact name ($CARDAMOM_BOARD).
      --actor=ACTOR    Identity that owns active claims and attributes changes.
                       Defaults to the current OS username ($CARDAMOM_ACTOR).
      --json           Emit machine-readable JSON or JSON Lines output.
  -q, --quiet          Suppress status notices while preserving requested output
                       and errors.
